slot.brief: Piecewise function with a, b parameters; find values making it continuous at the junction (possibly also matching one-sided limits).

stem: For which values of $a$ and $b$ is $f$ continuous at both $x=1$ and $x=3$? $$f(x)=\begin{cases}x^2+ax,&x<1,\\2ax+b,&1\le x<3,\\x^2+bx,&x\ge3.\end{cases}$$

verdicts.working: Continuity at 1 gives 1+a=2a+b, so a+b=1. Continuity at 3 gives 6a+b=9+3b, so 3a-b=9/2. Solving yields (a,b)=(11/8,-3/8), option A.

working:
At $x=1$: $1+a=2a+b$; at $x=3$: $6a+b=9+3b$. Thus $b=1-a$ and $8a=11$, giving $(a,b)=(\dfrac{11}{8},-\dfrac{3}{8})$.

Independent check: Continuity at 1 gives 1+a=2a+b, so a+b=1. Continuity at 3 gives 6a+b=9+3b, so 3a-b=9/2. Solving yields (a,b)=(11/8,-3/8), option A.
solution:
Continuity at $x=1$ and $x=3$ requires
$$1+a=2a+b,\qquad 6a+b=9+3b.$$
Thus $a+b=1$ and $3a-b=\frac{9}{2}$, giving $a=\frac{11}{8}$ and $b=-\frac{3}{8}$.
